implementation.project_scope: immutable subject graph plus validated metadata project hint
implementation.pagination: bounded limit (1..100), event_id descending cursor; filter-before-pagination
implementation.redaction: recursive metadata key and bearer/token text redaction; local path references masked
implementation.export_proof: read-only GET /api/v1/audit-events/proof computes a bounded SHA-256 chain over the redacted export projection, using the same filters and stable event-id cursor semantics; max_events is clamped to 1000
implementation.ui: AuditHistoryPanel in diagnostics with explicit filters, loading/error/empty states and older-event cursor

production_uat.reason: 正式 Windows x64 项目三视口审计历史 UAT、深链接恢复和最终 release evidence 尚未执行；不把自动化回归冒充最终 PASS。

remaining_limits: 历史事件缺少独立 project_id 列，项目过滤依赖 subject 关系解析；未归属项目的全局 Runtime/Profile 事件仅在全局视图展示。
链式证明是有界、只读的脱敏导出投影证明，不是数据库级持久化防篡改链；备份介质、跨机恢复和正式发布签字仍需 UAT/发布证据。
